title: Prime conjugacy and residue-automorphism lifting in finite Galois normalization
statement: Let $A$ be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with fraction field $F$, let $E/F$ be a finite Galois extension (finite-dimensional, normal and separable) [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], where normal means that the minimal polynomial over $F$ of each element of $E$ splits into linear factors in $E[T]$, and let $B$ be the integral closure of $A$ in $E$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The group $G=\operatorname{Gal}(E/F)$ of $F$-automorphisms of $E$ acts on $B$ by restriction. For any prime ideals $\mathfrak q,\mathfrak q'$ of $B$ with $\mathfrak q\cap A=\mathfrak q'\cap A$, there exists $g\in G$ with $g(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak q'$. For every prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$, put $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q\cap A$ and define $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=\operatorname{Frac}(B/\mathfrak q)$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\operatorname{Frac}(A/\mathfrak p)$. Every $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-automorphism of $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ is induced by an element of $\{g\in G:g(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak q\}$.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per clause after the common finite Galois normalization setup. Read pinned Mathlib/RingTheory/Invariant/Galois.lean:26-61: IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction (line 34) is restriction of Gal(E/F) to B, and Algebra.isInvariant_of_isGalois (line 45) supplies Algebra.IsInvariant A B Gal(E/F). For the fraction-field setup, install the explicit theorem integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension A F E (Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/Integral.lean:428-430); this theorem is not an instance. The canonical integral closure has integrality and integral-closure instances. The restriction action fixes A: g(a b)=g(a)g(b)=a g(b), which supplies SMulCommClass. With this invariant instance, the first clause is Algebra.IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq (Mathlib/RingTheory/Invariant/Basic.lean:147), evaluated at the two prime ideals (its Q = g • P is exactly image-prime conjugacy). The second clause is IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom_surjective (same Basic.lean:353) with P=p, Q=q, K=Frac(A/p), L=Frac(B/q); no maximality or separability assumption on the residue extension is imposed. The finite Galois hypothesis gives Finite Gal(E/F).
